Strategy: Reward bins whose post-placement residual lands between thirty and fifty percent of the roomiest open bin, adapting the sweet band to each state, while keeping the mid penalty. This scales the target with the current spread, but the fractions are guesses and the band may rarely trigger.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r - item >= 0.3 * max(bins) and r - item <= 0.5 * max(bins) else 0) - (20 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
